s.note: Harold's life run to the second
s.how: Butter the outsides of 8 slices of bread and fill 4 sandwiches with 150g ham and 150g grated cheddar. Cook in a pan over medium heat for exactly 3 minutes a side and cut into neat triangles.

Beat 125g butter with 100g brown sugar and 50g caster sugar, add 1 egg and vanilla, then 200g plain flour and 1 tsp baking powder. Roll into 16 balls and bake at 180C for 11 minutes until just golden.

m.note: a night in after another audit
m.how: Cook 800g diced chicken thigh with 2 sliced leeks in 30g butter. Stir in 2 tbsp flour, 300ml chicken stock and 100ml cream and simmer 10 minutes. Spoon into a dish, top with puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

w.note: the plate of cookies Ana gives Harold
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g brown sugar, add 1 egg, then 200g plain flour, 1 tsp bicarb soda and 150g chocolate chips. Bake 16 spoonfuls at 180C for 11 minutes. Serve warm with cold milk.

d.note: a glass of milk with the cookies
d.how: Chill 1L full cream milk until very cold. Pour into 4 tall glasses and serve with the cookies. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
